video_title: Boogie & Lou - Jalen Brunson DESERVES a Statue!! Best Knick Player All-Time!?!

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's historic season and place among Knicks greats
quotes.excerpt: When it comes to talking to the greats to ever put on that uniform, you have to put him up there.
quotes.quote: If he is not, his name is definitely being mentioned amongst the greats. Incredible year for Brunson, going from winning an NBA cup, Finals MVP, to now being a champion under this organization. It has been a long time since this Knicks organization has even had a chance to be at this point. So when it comes to talking to the greats to ever put on that uniform, you have to put him up there. You have to think of people like Willis Reed and the big fella Walt Frazier, Patrick Ewing. Obviously those type names come up, but you have to start mentioning Jalen Brunson from this point moving forward.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's consistent confidence and impressive playoff performance
quotes.excerpt: He just continues to stay confident, continues to play his style of basketball.
quotes.quote: I just feel like ever since his first season with the Knicks, he was their guy. He could do no wrong and now he does this and brings a championship the first time in 53 years. It is unbelievable what he did. He just continues to stay confident, continues to play his style of basketball. He picked and shoes unbelievable. In this game particularly, this is one of the more impressive playoff games I have ever seen in my life.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams advocates for a Jalen Brunson statue
quotes.excerpt: Statue? Give it to him. Give it to him. Since he's come over from Dallas, he's succeeded all expectations.
quotes.quote: Statue? Give it to him. Give it to him. Since he's come over from Dallas, he's succeeded all expectations from being a small guard to putting the New York Knicks back on the map and winning the championship, doing it in high fashion, Finals MVP. He's been a leader of this crew since he's been there. He's been the best player in his short tenure with the Knicks, and now that he's brought a championship, we love our nostalgia.

quotes.speaker: Michelle Beadle
quotes.summary_phrase: Michelle Beadle questions the listed heights of NBA players
quotes.excerpt: Steph is listed at 6'2, lie. Jalen Brunson listed at 6'2, lie.
quotes.quote: I think there are lies being told. Steph is listed at 6'2, lie. Jalen Brunson listed at 6'2, lie. They are lying in two different directions and I don't even understand why. Brunson is definitely not 6'2 because I stood next to him.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins on Jalen Brunson's elite status
quotes.excerpt: I think he's proven himself time and time again and this year, this was the icing on the cake.
quotes.quote: I think he's proven himself time and time again and this year, this was the icing on the cake. From him taking a pay cut to kind of helping fund this team as far as how it was built around him, he deserves credit for that and he ended up getting the ultimate prize of winning the championship. It shows that his sacrifice was worth it. He made the guys around him better, a very, very well put together team, constructed greatly, especially with the way that Brunson plays.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams praises the Knicks' championship run
quotes.excerpt: That team did everything they needed to do to go win a championship.
quotes.quote: That team did everything they needed to do to go win a championship. All odds were against them. Nobody favored the New York Knicks. I saw a clip where I told Jalen Brunson to his face, I picked the Knicks to come out of the East. I just said to come out of the East, right? They exceeded all expectations from being a small guard to putting the New York Knicks back on the map and winning the championship, doing it in high fashion, Finals MVP.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons credits Mike Brown's coaching adjustments
quotes.excerpt: Mike Brown did a great job kind of switching up his rotations with the bench.
quotes.quote: Mike Brown did a great job kind of switching up his rotations with the bench. He got way more production than Tom Thibodeau did with pretty much this same roster. Jalen Brunson is still going to have the usage rate, but then we saw flashes of KAT being great. We saw OG was unbelievable throughout this entire playoffs.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons on the Knicks' historic point differential
quotes.excerpt: That great Warriors team that we talk about, the best team ever outside the MJ's Bulls.
quotes.quote: That great Warriors team that we talk about, the best team ever outside the Michael Jordan's Bulls, they were at plus 230. So they blew those numbers. So yes, analytically, which is a funny word this postseason to say, they've had a great, great run and a historic run. They dominated the entire Eastern Conference throughout this playoffs.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams on the Knicks' balanced team effort
quotes.excerpt: You can make a case that they're the most balanced team.
quotes.quote: You can make a case that they're the most balanced team. Now, probably when it comes to the name game, it's probably not the sexiest group that you can imagine, but when you talk about a team, everybody played their part. Like they're not, you know, like Brunson, KAT, OG, all of these guys, they're still are, they still are legends in the making. I think they're still doing their thing, right? But when we look at a lot of those teams, when we talk about them and we compare them, them guys already legends.
